summary: PNC Financial Services Group filed an 8-K announcing the full redemption on Nov. 1, 2026 (shifted to Nov. 2, 2026, a non-business day) of all 525,000 outstanding Depositary Shares (CUSIP 693475 AQ8) representing $525 million of its Fixed-to-Floating Rate Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series S, each a 1/100th interest. Redemption price is $1,000 per Depositary Share, excluding declared but unpaid dividends, which are paid separately to holders of record. Shares held via DTC and redeemed through Computershare Trust Company, N.A. as Depositary. Watch preferred redemption mechanics and dividend record-date timing.
